item.title: Tariffs and falling demand leave Scotch distillers under pressure
item.description: Dozens of Scottish distilleries are showing signs of financial distress as exports to the US and China weaken, tariffs bite and domestic demand shifts away from spirits. Read more: Tariffs and falling demand leave Scotch distillers under pressure

item.title: Retail spending rebounds in January after weak Christmas
item.description: UK retail sales rose 2.7% year-on-year in January, according to the BRC and KPMG, as shoppers took advantage of post-Christmas discounts following a subdued festive period. Read more: Retail spending rebounds in January after weak Christmas

item.title: Mozart AI raises $6m to put artists at the heart of AI-powered music creation
item.description: London-based Mozart AI has raised $6m in a seed round led by Balderton Capital as it accelerates growth of its AI-powered music creation platform and launches a mobile app. Read more: Mozart AI raises $6m to put artists at the heart of AI-powered music creation

item.title: Oatly loses ‘milk’ branding battle in UK Supreme Court
item.description: Oatly has lost a Supreme Court challenge over its “post-milk generation” slogan, after judges ruled plant-based drinks cannot use protected dairy terms under UK and EU-derived law. Read more: Oatly loses ‘milk’ branding battle in UK Supreme Court

item.title: Children ‘bombarded’ with weight-loss drug ads online, commissioner warns
item.description: England’s children’s commissioner says young people are routinely exposed to online adverts for weight-loss injections and cosmetic procedures, calling for tougher social media regulation. Read more: Children ‘bombarded’ with weight-loss drug ads online, commissioner warns

item.title: Lloyds Banking Group to close 95 more branches across UK
item.description: Lloyds Banking Group will shut 95 more branches across Lloyds, Halifax and Bank of Scotland, citing falling footfall as customers shift to mobile banking. Read more: Lloyds Banking Group to close 95 more branches across UK

item.title: Norfolk police chief calls for tougher penalties for prolific shoplifters
item.description: Norfolk’s chief constable has urged swifter and tougher sentencing for repeat shoplifters as reported offences continue to rise and court backlogs persist. Read more: Norfolk police chief calls for tougher penalties for prolific shoplifters

item.title: Tangible raises $4.3m seed round to unlock scalable debt finance for hardtech firms
item.description: Fintech startup Tangible has secured $4.3m in seed funding led by Pale Blue Dot to help hardtech companies access structured debt finance and reduce reliance on dilutive equity. Read more: Tangible raises $4.3m seed round to unlock scalable debt finance for hardtech firms

item.title: Ford overtaken by BYD as China reshapes global car industry
item.description: Ford has been overtaken in global sales by China’s BYD, highlighting the rapid rise of electric carmakers as Western manufacturers struggle with the EV transition. Read more: Ford overtaken by BYD as China reshapes global car industry

item.title: City stalwart Schroders to be sold to US rival in £9.9bn deal
item.description: Schroders has agreed a £9.9bn takeover by US asset manager Nuveen, ending more than 200 years of independence in a blow to the London Stock Exchange. Read more: City stalwart Schroders to be sold to US rival in £9.9bn deal
